commands.short: CLI, MCP server, and AI agent to automate YouTube workflows
commands.long:
yutu is a CLI, MCP server, and AI agent that automates your YouTube workflows from the terminal or any AI client.

Environment variables:
  YUTU_CREDENTIAL    Path/Base64/JSON of OAuth client secret (default: client_secret.json)
  YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN   Path/Base64/JSON of cached OAuth token (default: youtube.token.json)
  YUTU_ROOT          Root directory for file resolution (default: current working directory)
  YUTU_LOG_LEVEL     Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR (default: INFO)

children.long: Manage YouTube abuse reports. Use this tool to report abusive content on YouTube.
Create an abuse report. Use this tool to report abusive content on YouTube such as spam, harassment, or violent content.
children.example:
# Report a video as spam
yutu abuseReport insert --abuseTypes spam --subjectId VIDEO_ID --subjectTypeId video --description "This video is spam"
# Report a comment as harassment
yutu abuseReport insert --abuseTypes harassment --subjectId COMMENT_ID --subjectTypeId comment --description "Harassment in comment"

flags.name: subjectId
flags.usage: ID of the subject being reported

flags.name: subjectTypeId
flags.usage: Type ID of the subject (e.g., video, comment, channel)

flags.name: subjectUrl
flags.usage: URL of the subject being reported

children.long: Manage YouTube activities. Use this tool to list channel activities.
List activities. Use this tool to list activities such as uploads, likes, and favorites.
children.example:
# List my activities
yutu activity list --for mine
# List activities by channel ID with limit
yutu activity list --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --maxResults 10
# List activities after a date in JSON format
yutu activity list --publishedAfter 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z --output json

flags.name: maxResults
flags.usage: The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit

flags.name: publishedAfter
flags.usage: Filter on activities published after this date

flags.name: publishedBefore
flags.usage: Filter on activities published before this date

flags.name: regionCode
flags.usage: Display the content as seen by viewers in this country

children.short: Start an agent to automate YouTube workflows
children.long: Start an agent to automate YouTube workflows.
children.example:
# Gemini(compatible) (default)
yutu agent --provider google --model gemini-3.8-flash --api-key "YOUR_KEY"
yutu agent --provider google --model gemini-3.8-flash --api-key "YOUR_KEY" --base-url "https://custom.endpoint.com/"
# OpenAI(compatible) (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama, vLLM, etc.)
yutu agent --provider openai --model gpt-5.6-terra --api-key "YOUR_KEY"
yutu agent --provider openai --model deepseek-flash --api-key "YOUR_KEY" --base-url "https://api.deepseek.com/"

flags.usage: API key for the model provider

flags.name: args

flags.name: base-url
flags.usage: Base URL for the model provider's API endpoint

children.short: Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
children.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for yutu for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

children.short: Generate the autocompletion script for bash
children.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(yutu completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	yutu completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/yutu

#### macOS:

	yutu completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/yutu

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

children.short: Generate the autocompletion script for fish
children.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the fish shell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	yutu completion fish | source

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

	yutu completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/yutu.fish

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

children.short: Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
children.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	yutu completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.

children.short: Generate the autocompletion script for zsh
children.long:
Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need
to enable it.  You can execute the following once:

	echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(yutu completion zsh)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	yutu completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_yutu"

#### macOS:

	yutu completion zsh > $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_yutu

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

Help provides help for any command in the application.
Simply type yutu help [path to command] for full details.
